name: Procter & Gamble

business_roles.scope_note: Household and personal care products only; it sells no food or drink. Research each reporting segment separately, since their inputs, competitors and store-brand pressure differ.

observables_to_research: organic sales growth split into volume, price and mix, by segment
gross margin and the stated effect of commodity costs, pricing and productivity
the stated effect of currency on sales and earnings

exposures.mechanism_hypothesis: It reports in US dollars and makes a large part of its sales in other currencies, so a stronger dollar lowers reported sales and earnings even when volumes abroad are unchanged.

edge_conditions.lead:consumer_products:agricultural_comm: Pursue this lead for Procter & Gamble only for an agricultural material it names as an input, such as a plant oil used in cleaning products. Food crops, and shocks to them, are context only: it makes no food.
